checkedAlternates.risk: Sovereign wealth funds invest in government bonds.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A sovereign wealth fund is a state-owned net asset pool (group-1), the opposite of issuing sovereign debt liabilities (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Pensions are a large share of government spending.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Statutory pensions are mandatory formula-driven entitlements (group-2), not annually appropriated discretionary spending (group-3).
